schema.$comment: Shared vocabulary proposal from the incumbent Foundry dessim robot aspects. Open to fields a newer writer adds. Numbers name their units; they are robot figures, not positions in a frame.

profile.description: A symmetric trapezoidal speed profile. An omitted deceleration equals acceleration; consumers may refuse unequal acceleration and deceleration until supported.
